_source: HCM 7th Edition, Chapter 30, Section 8, Example Problem 1: Motorized Vehicle LOS — westbound direction (identical published results to eastbound by symmetry: Exhibit 30-36). This case exercises the Exhibit 18-13 planning-level access-point turning-delay estimate instead of the supplied Chapter 30 Section 4 per-point delays of case1: 2 active access points (Exhibit 30-31), turn percentages from the Exhibit 30-35 access point volumes (left 75.56/1,161.7 = 6.5%, right 94.45/1,161.7 = 8.1%; the JSON uses 6.5 and 8.1), no turn bays at the access points. The Exhibit 18-13 estimate gives 0.37 s/veh/pt at 575 veh/h/ln (x 0.73 turn-percentage factor = 0.270 s/veh/pt, total 0.540 s vs. the published Section 4 procedure total of 0.387 s), so the computed running time is 33.70 s vs. the published 33.54 s and the computed travel speed 23.60 mi/h vs. the published 23.67 mi/h -- within the documented +/-0.5 mi/h fixture tolerance. Base FFS (40.78 mi/h), LOS (C), v/c (0.52), and perception score (2.53) reproduce exactly.
